note: Datasets investigated for SHADOWTRACE. status = ingested (used in the deployed engine) | investigated (documented, not ingested yet). Every number on screen traces to an ingested entry or to a calculation over them.

datasets.name: LRO LOLA polar DEM LDEM_75S_240M
datasets.source: NASA PDS Geosciences Node, data set LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
datasets.temporalCoverage: LOLA altimetry accumulated since 2009 (static terrain product)
datasets.coordinateSystem: South polar stereographic on a 1737.4 km sphere, centre 90°S / 0°E
datasets.units: metres relative to 1737.4 km reference radius (int16 × 0.5 m scaling factor)
datasets.format: PDS3 IMG, 16-bit signed little-endian, detached LBL
datasets.processing: scripts/prepare_lola240.py: read LBL keywords, crop to 3812×3812, gzip int16 → public/data/lola_south_240m.bin.gz. SHA-256 of source recorded in lola_south_240m.json; Shackleton/Faustini depth check.
datasets.limitations: Gridded from altimeter tracks with interpolation between them; slopes are only resolved over ≥ 480 m baselines; cannot see boulders or small craters.

datasets.name: LRO LOLA polar DEM LDEM_85S_20M (averaged to 40 m)
datasets.source: NASA PDS Geosciences Node, data set LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0
datasets.access: HTTPS download (public), same PDS polar IMG directory
datasets.format: PDS3 IMG → 225 gzip tiles of 512×512 int16 (public/data/dem40/)
datasets.processing: scripts/prepare_dem40.py: 2×2 block mean, tile, gzip; median difference vs 240 m grid = 13.5 m (recorded in dem40/meta.json).
datasets.limitations: Averaging to 40 m smooths metre-scale relief. A large share of polar LDEM pixels are interpolated between laser shots (Barker et al., 2021). Slopes are evaluated over ≥ 80 m baselines.

datasets.name: Sun and Earth apparent positions as seen from the Moon
datasets.instrument: NASA JPL Horizons ephemeris system (DE440-series planetary ephemerides)
datasets.coordinateSystem: Moon body-fixed (selenographic) sub-solar / sub-Earth points + distances
datasets.processing: scripts/fetch_horizons.py, verified by scripts/verify_horizons.py against 1,248 direct topocentric queries: max error Sun 0.0002°, Earth 0.006°.
datasets.limitations: Hourly samples interpolated to the simulation step (10 min). Libration is included by Horizons.

datasets.name: Artemis III candidate regions and permanently shadowed regions (south pole)
datasets.instrument: Derived products served by NASA Moon Trek
datasets.source: NASA Moon Trek (trek.nasa.gov) public ArcGIS feature services A3_Named_regions_SP and PSR_SP
datasets.access: Public ArcGIS REST query endpoints (no account) — scripts/fetch_moontrek_vectors.py
datasets.processing: PSRs are stored as point + area; SHADOWTRACE approximates each as an equal-area circle for context only.
datasets.limitations: Moon Trek's advanced mission-planning tools need registered accounts; only the public basic services are used. PSR circles are approximations.

datasets.name: IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (named craters)
datasets.limitations: Only named craters: crater proximity is context, not a hazard map.

datasets.name: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit textures
datasets.source: NASA Goddard Scientific Visualization Studio, https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/
datasets.limitations: Optimised for aesthetics, not science. Never used in any calculation.

datasets.name: LRO Diviner polar thermal products (PRP, PCP)
datasets.source: NASA PDS Geosciences Node — Diviner derived bundle urn:nasa:pds:lro_diviner_derived1 (PRP: LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0)
datasets.access: Public HTTPS download from PDS Geosciences / Lunar ODE (no account)
datasets.spatialResolution: PRP: triangular mesh to 80°; PCP: 240 m polar stereographic bins
datasets.format: ASCII tables (+ rasters for newer PCP)
datasets.processing: Not yet ingested: the PCP tables are hundreds of MB per bin and need server-side reduction to a static grid.
datasets.limitations: Not used: the app reports 'thermal not assessed' rather than estimating temperatures.

datasets.name: LOLA polar illumination & Earth-visibility maps (Mazarico et al., 2011)
datasets.source: NASA GSFC PGDA product 69 / LOLA PDS node
datasets.access: Public download (PDS IMG int16 and GeoJPEG2000)
datasets.temporalCoverage: averages over an 18.6-year cycle, hourly steps
datasets.units: fraction of time illuminated / Earth visible
datasets.processing: Used as a cross-check reference only; SHADOWTRACE computes time-specific illumination for the chosen dates instead of long-term averages.
datasets.limitations: Long-term averages cannot answer 'what happens on my dates'.

datasets.name: LROC NAC images and WAC polar illumination maps
datasets.instrument: LRO Camera (NAC 0.5 m/px, WAC 100 m/px polar products)
datasets.source: LROC PDS archive https://pds.lroc.im-ldi.com/data/ (LRO-L-LROC-5-RDR-V1.0, e.g. WAC_POLE_ILL_TWI_SOUTH_100M)
datasets.spatialResolution: NAC ~0.5 m/px; WAC polar maps 100 m/px
datasets.coordinateSystem: NAC: raw/map-projected strips; WAC map: polar stereographic
datasets.processing: Not ingested: boulder mapping from NAC needs shadow-aware detection over grazing-sun images, outside this iteration.
datasets.limitations: Without NAC-scale analysis, boulders and craters < ~80 m are not assessed (stated in every result).

datasets.name: NAIF SPICE kernels (LRO, Moon frames)
datasets.processing: Not needed at run time: JPL Horizons already supplies the Sun/Earth geometry (verified). Kept as the route for relay-satellite geometry when public relay ephemerides exist.
datasets.limitations: No public ephemerides for planned south-pole relay orbiters, so relay coverage is not assessed.
